Product Description

When Your Skills Need To Shine On Indoor Courts, Lace Up Adidas Samba Boots. With Decades Of Football Heritage Behind Them, They'll Keep You Comfortable With A Soft Leather Upper Featuring Suede Overlays For Added Abrasion Resistance. A Rubber Outsole Provides Biting Grip To Help You Change Direction On A Dime, And An Eva Insole Helps Smooth Out Every Sprint.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love these shoes for their classic Adidas style and trendy vibe, finding them comfortable with no foot pain during wear. However, the fit receives mixed feedback, with some finding them true to size while others note they run a little large. Moreover, authenticity is a concern as many customers report they are obviously fake. Additionally, customers find the shoes squeaky.
